diffs.why: Environmental, not a data diff (R-DA; operator y 2026-10-19, replay night N1): the step's first stdout line prints the target's applied-migration count ("target: … migrations=<n> (floor …)"). It moves whenever a migration lands between the committed POST and its retake — N1 applied 266, 267, 268 and 273, so it reads migrations=264 where the committed POST read 260. The R-DK stability half compares every retaken POST with the committed one, so every migration night shows this line. Night 1 recapture 2026-10-21 (REFREEZE-BUNDLE-1 split by R-II; public re-acquisition per operator CHAT-28; Spec 124 R-DA): INPUT DRIFT traced to load_centreline's source drift: centreline_count / toronto_centreline 47330 -> 47331, so the frontage-street estimates re-derive (estimated 1510409 -> 1510419, estimate_negative 47716 -> 47718, no_frontage_street 60954 -> 60942) and 39 parcel_abutments rows update (standalone records_updated 0 -> 39); table_state content_hash moves (448d1039 -> 8a88b65f). This is the R-DK net-new stability half: committed POST vs this POST. NOT CODE: the night's runtime edits are runLinkPhase extra_counters (R-IG; this step declares none, so no key and no behaviour change, lock type-counters T6) and descriptor/notes/guard text that no runner reads at run time; they move lib_fingerprint (fef97e27 -> 93b059a9) and source_fingerprint, not this output. ENVIRONMENT: the first stdout line names the local dev DB's applied-migration count, now 268 (264/266 at the 2026-10-19/20 captures; migrations other lanes applied to the local DB since), and run-scoped log text (durations, pipeline_runs ids, before-image file timestamps) differs every run.
